clue.text: Main track in thoughts when cycling

clue.text: Head of Dorchester hotel can supply various events

clue.text: Main witness by the sound of it

clue.text: One who scoffs as fashionable fancy man finally takes husband's place

the last letters of these two words

clue.text: Erroneous fines discovered by a court

taken as written

clue.text: Badly steer most of spray over grass

the letters as written
the letters as written

taken as written

clue.text: What 2 down is to provide settlement in other words

clue.text: Navy uniform initially remains here?

clue.text: Very much hate felon working without any electronics
